name: Our Green House

sites.name: Our Green House
sites.notes: BigCommerce store (gift baskets). Reviewed read-only: no payment, contact or newsletter forms are submitted and nothing is changed on the live site.

performance.note: Lighthouse lab run on the homepage and a product page. Used for layout stability and load time; no Before/After scores are reported for this client.

security.note: Browser pass (headers, cookies, script and network errors, third-party tools) plus secure-address redirect and insecure-content checks.

seo.note: Sitemap and robots checks plus a sample of 19 pages (title, description, headings, canonical, sharing tags, structured data).

availability.note: Every page linked from the header, menus and footer: status, redirects and response time.

functional.note: Search, category, product, add to cart, quantity, coupon message, checkout screen (view only), remove, sign-in messages.

responsive.note: Desktop, tablet and phone screenshots and sideways-scroll check.

cache.reason: No API runner for hosting cache metrics.

secrets.purpose: Google PageSpeed Insights API (optional; local Lighthouse is used without it)
UptimeRobot read-only API key (optional; a live probe is used without it)

inputs.notes: No Before/After PageSpeed scores for this client. Do NOT ask for them.

context: BigCommerce gift-basket store (ourgreenhouse.com). The monthly report is a plain-language website health and maintenance deck (not a performance-score report). Everything is reviewed read-only: guest cart actions only, checkout is viewed but never submitted, no contact or newsletter forms are sent.
